content: Melvin-Koushki says Ibn Turka's comparison of himself to Ghazālī and Rāzī, his self-presentation as a standard-issue Ashʿarī thinker, and his appeals to the (pointedly non-messianic) orthodoxy of Khwāja Pārsā are to be taken ‘with several grains of salt’, because they tally too easily with Shāhrukh's Sunnizing programme and give the lie to much of the author's oeuvre.
refers_to_primary: Ibn Turka, R. Iʿtiqādiyya, p.268; Nafsat al-Maṣdūr I, pp.172, 187-8, 193 (per MK fn.44)
